vendors.name: Cribl Stream
vendors.offering: Vendor-neutral pipeline to filter, reduce and route logs before SIEM
vendors.pricing: Free up to 1TB/day (no license); Cribl.Cloud paid via Cribl Credits ($1 = 1 credit); self-managed Standard license $4,800 for up to 100GB/day

vendors.name: Datadog Observability Pipelines
vendors.offering: Filter, sample, drop and route logs/security data before downstream tools
vendors.pricing: $0.095-$0.12 per ingested GB/month; Plus $1,950-$2,808 per vCPU/month

vendors.name: Observo AI (SentinelOne)
vendors.offering: AI data pipeline claiming up to 80% SIEM volume reduction with rehydration

vendors.name: Tenzir
vendors.offering: Security data pipeline platform, open-source engine, on-prem and air-gapped
vendors.pricing: Community Edition free up to 1TB/day; paid editions not public

vendors.name: Edge Delta
vendors.offering: Telemetry pipelines with edge processing for logs, metrics and security data
vendors.pricing: reported free pipeline throughput since April 2026; storage 0.25 credits/GB (third-party)

vendors.name: Blumira
vendors.offering: SMB SIEM with prebuilt noise-filtered detections, unlimited ingest, 1-year retention
vendors.pricing: per knowledge-worker employee, flat, no data limits; ~$12-$21/employee/month (third-party)

vendors.name: Huntress Managed SIEM
vendors.offering: Managed SIEM with source-side Smart Filtering and 24/7 SOC
vendors.pricing: per data source, pooled volume; dollar rate not public

vendors.name: Graylog Security
vendors.offering: SIEM/log management; Graylog Open free, Security licensed by volume
vendors.pricing: from 10 GB/day or 100 GCUs; dollar price not public (Open free, no cap)

paid_market_gaps.gap: Teams drop logs to cut cost, creating forensic blind spots; need detection-aware filtering with cheap archive and rehydration
Independent pipeline vendors are being absorbed by SIEM/XDR vendors, shrinking vendor-neutral options
Pipeline tools are priced and built for enterprises (per-vCPU tiers, credits); small teams must author filters themselves
Free ingest grants cover only the SIEM vendor's own sources; third-party sources stay volume-billed

wtp_evidence: Large enterprises spend ~$2.5M/yr on logging and 67% say cost outweighs value; SentinelOne paid ~$225M for Observo. Small teams lean on flat-priced SMB SIEMs or free tiers.
bundling_note: Cribl gives 1TB/day free, Edge Delta reportedly made pipeline throughput free, Graylog Open is uncapped, and Microsoft Sentinel ingests Azure Activity/O365 audit logs free plus E5 grants.
summary: Crowded: Cribl, Datadog and SIEM-owned pipelines serve enterprises, flat-priced SMB SIEMs (Blumira, Huntress) bake in noise filtering, and free tiers abound. Thin opening only for detection-aware, vendor-neutral reduction packaged for MSPs or small teams.
